objective: Bring two Mithril Coifs and one Ornate Mithril Shoulder to Trenton Lighthammer.

description: It seems as if master had this planned from the start. I was not taught to create the items which you learned to create and you were not taught the items which I learned to create.
The master is wise, <name>. We shall teach each other!
Show me how to make a mithril coif and ornate mithril shoulders and I shall show you how to create an ornate mithril helm.
progress: Have you completed the crafting of the items, <name>?
completion: Excellent! A fair tradeoff, if I do say so myself. Watch and learn, <name>!
